name: ui-interactive-cli
description: Interactive CLI session with readline loop, slash commands, and optional shell mode

enabled.description: Whether this extension is enabled. Set to false to disable the extension entirely.

shellMode.description: When enabled, lines starting with a recognized system command are executed directly instead of sent to the agent.

pasteMarkerMinChars.description: Minimum length (characters) for a single-line paste to be shown as a [Paste #N] marker; shorter single-line pastes are inserted into the line as-is. Set to 0 to always use the marker.

cli:flags.description: Execute lines starting with a recognized system command directly
